subject: S05f on shared at 5af5120: required ui_copy keys + shared uiText() fallback
body:
ui_copy now has REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS (apps/api/naadi_api/config_api/schemas.py): every key the web reads, including seg06's content.* and seg04's agent.*. An admin PUT or a seed that drops one is a 422 listing the missing keys.

@naadi/shared exports uiText(copy, key, vars) and UI_COPY_DEFAULTS (packages/shared/ui-copy.defaults.json, generated from config/app_config.yaml; regenerate with `UPDATE_UI_COPY_DEFAULTS=1 uv run pytest tests/config_api/test_ui_copy_defaults.py` after changing ui_copy; CI fails when it is stale). React hook: apps/web/src/copy/useUiText.ts.

seg03: the callback messages, SignInPage state labels ('Sign in', 'Sending…', 'Opening Google…', 'No email sent') and AccountPage sign-out labels are now ui_copy (callback.*, signin.*, account.*). CallbackResult no longer carries `message`; CallbackPage renders callback.<kind>. All texts unchanged, so e2e locators still match.

Everyone: when you add a key the web reads, add it to REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS and config/app_config.yaml, then regenerate the defaults file.
